dialog.about.title: About PoseCascade
dialog.about.body:
PoseCascade — PySide6 + OpenGL engine for importing 3D scenes
and driving them with sandboxed scripts, spring chains, and PBD cloth.
dialog.empty_scene.title: Empty scene
dialog.empty_scene.body:
Script {name!r} is being loaded into an empty scene.

Most demo scripts look up nodes by name in their start() hook — those lookups return None against an empty scene and the script silently does nothing.

Load a scene first via File → Open Scene, then re-open the script.
dialog.language.restart_body: The interface language has been set to {language}. Restart PoseCascade for the change to apply to every panel.
viewport.tooltip: 3D viewport. Left-drag to orbit, middle-drag to pan, wheel to zoom. Press F to frame the selected node.
outliner.title: Outliner
outliner.tooltip: Scene hierarchy. Click a node to inspect / edit it on the right. Right-click for actions. Press Delete to remove the selected node and its descendants.
inspector.title: Inspector
inspector.components.tooltip: Components attached to this node — physics chains, cloth pieces, skin references etc. Tuners for each component appear below.
inspector.components.list_tooltip: Read-only list of component types on this node.
inspector.spring.title: SpringChain: {name}
inspector.spring.tooltip.stiffness: Spring constant pulling each joint back to its rest pose. Higher = stiffer hair / cloth, less sway. Typical 8–20.
inspector.spring.tooltip.damping: Velocity damping each frame. Higher = less ringing after an impulse. Typical 0.3–0.8.
inspector.spring.tooltip.inertia: Per-joint mass — heavier joints respond more slowly to wind / head motion. Typical 0.01–0.05 for hair.
inspector.cloth.title: Cloth: {name}
inspector.cloth.tooltip.stiffness: How rigidly the cloth resists stretching along its weave (PBD structural constraint). 0 = rubbery, 1 = rigid. Typical 0.6–0.9.
inspector.cloth.tooltip.bend: Resistance to folding / wrinkling. 0 = limp, 1 = card-stiff. Typical 0.1–0.3 for cloth, higher for leather.
inspector.cloth.tooltip.damping: Per-frame velocity multiplier (1 = no damping, 0.5 = aggressive damp). Lower = faster settle after an impulse.
inspector.cloth.tooltip.rest_pull: Force pulling vertices back toward their rest position each frame. Prevents drift / sag accumulation. Typical 5–40.
slot.title: Slots
slot.visibility.tooltip: Show / hide {name!r} in the viewport. Hidden slots still tick their physics + animation; only the draw is skipped.
slot.translation.tooltip: {name!r} world {axis} translation. Positions the slot's root before its own animation runs.
effects.title: Effects
effects.tooltip.up: Move the selected effect one slot earlier in the chain. Earlier = applied first to the source image.
effects.tooltip.down: Move the selected effect one slot later in the chain.
effects.tooltip.remove: Remove the selected effect from the chain. Use the Effects menu to add new ones.
effects.tooltip.enabled: Enable / disable this effect. Disabled effects keep their uniform values but are skipped during rendering.
timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.tooltip.slider: Scrub the playhead. Drag to preview a frame; release to settle.
timeline.tooltip.frame_spin: Current frame number. Type a number to jump straight there.
timeline.tooltip.play: Toggle playback. When playing, the playhead advances at the scene's FPS (or in sync with attached audio).
timeline.tooltip.range_start: Playback range start frame. Playback wraps to here when looping.
timeline.tooltip.range_end: Playback range end frame. Playback stops (or wraps) at this frame.
timeline.tooltip.loop: When checked, playback wraps from end → start instead of stopping at the range end.
tracks.title: Tracks
tracks.tooltip.insert: Insert a keyframe at the current playhead frame on the active track. Shortcut: I.
tracks.tooltip.delete: Delete the currently selected keyframe. Shortcut: Delete.
tracks.tooltip.undo: Undo the last keyframe insert / delete / move on this timeline.
tracks.tooltip.redo: Redo the last undone timeline edit.
animation_json.title: Animation JSON
animation_json.placeholder: Open a .json animation via File → Open Script, or paste JSON here.
animation_json.status.format_failed: Format aborted: JSON parse error at line {line}
animation_json.status.save_no_path: Save: no path bound; load a file first.

export.title: Export
export.tooltip.export: Run the export described by the active tab. Validates the output path before starting; nothing is written if validation fails.
export.tooltip.vmd_output: Destination .vmd path. The exporter writes a binary MMD motion file containing every visible track's keyframes.
export.tooltip.sequence_dir: Directory the per-frame PNGs are written to. Created if it doesn't exist; existing files in the range are overwritten.
export.tooltip.sequence_start: First frame to render (inclusive). Use the timeline to scrub and find the right frame numbers.
export.tooltip.padding: Zero-pad width for filenames. 4 → frame_0001.png, 6 → frame_000001.png.
export.tooltip.sequence_post: Apply the viewport's post-effect chain (bloom, tonemap, etc.) to each rendered frame. Uncheck to export the raw scene render.
export.tooltip.video_output: Destination video file path. Container is inferred from the extension (.mp4, .mov, .webm) and must match the codec.
export.tooltip.video_fps: Output video framerate. Must match the timeline's playback rate to keep audio sync; 30 / 60 are the common choices.
export.tooltip.video_codec: Video codec. h264 = wide compatibility, prores = lossless / editing-friendly but huge files, vp9 = good for web.
export.tooltip.video_post: Apply the viewport's post-effect chain to each encoded frame. Uncheck for a raw scene capture.
